content.title: B. Riley, Booz Allen, Fannie Mae & Freddie Mac: Trending Tickers
content.description:
Market Catalysts host Julie Hyman tracks several of the day's top trending stock tickers, including B. Riley Financial (RILY) filing its overdue 10-Q report to the SEC (US Securities and Exchange Commission) to avoid delisting, Booz Allen Hamilton (BAH) CFO Matt Calderone resigning from the company, and US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent commenting on his plans for Fannie Mae (FNMA) and Freddie Mac (FMCC) IPOs to come in 2026.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts.
